register_default_cls_arch: register the default FBNetV2 classification architecture blocks into the MODEL_ARCH registry
register_i8f_models: register int8-friendly variants of all classification models by calling get_i8f_models on the default arch
get_cls_arch_config: get a classification model architecture config from MODEL_ARCH by name using the get method
list_cls_arch_names: list all registered classification architecture names using MODEL_ARCH get_names
define_expansion_config: define an IR block expansion ratio config using the _ex helper with expansion and always_pw args
